name: Learn to Speak Easy
summary: Daily impromptu speaking practice with a timer and feedback; one prompt a day is free, and Pro is clearly priced in euros.
description: Learn to Speak Easy is an impromptu speaking practice app: you get a random prompt, a timed answer, and feedback. Pro adds unlimited prompts and full coaching (structure, what worked, what to work on next, and a transcript). The first 7 days of Pro are free, with no card. Euro prices include VAT. The legal name on the site is Norwich Website Design Ltd.

pricing.details: Free 0 € (one prompt a day, no card, no time limit). Pro 7.99 €/month or 54.99 €/year. First 7 days of Pro free, no card. Official euro prices, VAT included.
